title: Five successive malformed orchestration programs fail before inspection

source.evidence_note: Selected sanitized source H01 excerpts and tool SyntaxError results are in evidence/README.md. Five failed calls are observed; the record does not establish persistent code damage, hidden reasoning, model identity or a long-context cause.

horizon.earlier_event: H01:L209 submits prose to the JavaScript orchestration tool and L211 returns SyntaxError.
horizon.later_decision: H01:L229 submits another malformed JavaScript program after four previous syntax failures.
horizon.intervening_work: Three further malformed calls at L214, L219 and L224 fail before executing any nested inspection.
horizon.mechanism: Repeated invalid orchestration syntax; a local retry episode, not established instruction forgetting.

failure.expected_behavior: Submit syntactically valid orchestration JavaScript that invokes the inspection tool for the authorized schema/configuration task.
failure.observed_behavior: Five consecutive submitted programs fail parsing; no nested inspection executes in any of them. Valid inspection resumes at H01:L239/L241.
failure.target_predicate: With the expected JavaScript exec interface exposed, a submitted orchestration program fails parsing before the requested nested inspection runs. Repeated execution of malformed syntax is the incident; unrelated environment errors do not count.
